definitions.explanation: A pre-printed outline drawing meant to be filled in with colored pencils, markers, or paints. Also refers to the activity itself. Long popular as a children's pastime; adult coloring books became widely popular in the 2010s.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}が{塗|ぬ}り{絵|え}をしている。
{大人|おとな}{向|む}けの{塗|ぬ}り{絵|え}{本|ぼん}が{流行|はや}っている。
{塗|ぬ}り{絵|え}は{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}を{高|たか}め、ストレス{解消|かいしょう}にもなると{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Coloring is said to improve concentration and also relieve stress.

notes:
Compound of {塗|ぬ}る (to paint, to coat) + {絵|え} (picture). The verb stem connects directly to the noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {塗|ぬ}り{絵|え}をする: to do coloring
- {塗|ぬ}り{絵|え}{本|ぼん}: coloring book
- {大人|おとな}の{塗|ぬ}り{絵|え}: adult coloring (book/page)
- キャラクターの{塗|ぬ}り{絵|え}: character coloring pages

CULTURAL NOTE:
A standard preschool and early-elementary activity. The adult-coloring boom in Japan, partly imported from Europe, brought intricate mandala-style and floral books to mainstream bookstores. {塗|ぬ}り{絵|え}{療法|りょうほう} (coloring therapy) is sometimes used in mental-health and elderly-care settings.
